property_summary: For every input, after setL1BlockValues succeeds, c.basefee() equals the _basefee argument passed in; the mutant sets basefee to 0 (or keeps it stale) instead of _basefee, so any call with _basefee != 0 violates the rule.
change_summary: Delete the assignment `basefee = _basefee;` so basefee retains its previous value after setL1BlockValues.
